decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a distant, niche, project-based offer that appears only as a website mention, so its value is still highly uncertain; it costs little to keep listed, which makes it worth holding as an option into the maritime defense segment.

The medical examination light builds on existing competencies and has its own page, its institutional market prospects are still unfolding, and keeping it costs little, so the option is worth retaining.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's industrial customer base and its certified manufacturing, so the product fits well and is very likely to keep earning value.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core offer, so its demand is largely proven and it is cheap to keep in the portfolio.
